facts.F30: Formal verification: Quint 0.33.1 models the startup migrator protocol (two instances racing, crash before commit, previous-release edit after rollback, admin remove then re-add) in docs/feature/epic-6474-one-structure/design/models/organisation_structure_migrator.qnt; quint run (4000 samples, 10 steps) and quint verify (Apalache, 6 steps) found no violation of its six invariants, and each invariant was broken by its own mutant.
